faq.title: Questions? We have answers
faq.description: Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out and we'll gladly help.

items.question: Is Fibera free for tenants?
items.answer: Yes. Searching, saving rooms and contacting landlords is free, and we never charge hidden broker fees.

items.question: How are listings verified?
items.answer: Our team checks photos and key details on-site, so what you see on Fibera matches the real room.

items.question: What does AI moderation do?
items.answer: An AI model reads new posts in context and flags the ones that look misleading or inappropriate so they can be reviewed.

items.question: How do I book a viewing?
items.answer: Open a listing, choose an available time slot and send your request. The landlord will confirm the time with you.

items.question: I'm a landlord. How do I post a room?
items.answer: Create a landlord account, add your room details, photos and price, then publish. You can update slots and prices any time.
